name: Michigan MHSAA Lower Peninsula Cross Country Finals
headline: Michigan: No. 1 Natasza Dudek and No. 4 Ann Arbor Pioneer at MIS
summary: Ann Arbor Pioneer’s girls are No. 4 in DyeStat’s national team rankings, and Pioneer’s Natasza Dudek is the No. 1 girl in the country. Whitehall’s Robert Jazwinski III, No. 6 among boys, also races. All four Lower Peninsula divisions race at Michigan International Speedway.
